links.outcome: Manufacturer identification accuracy of ChatGPT 5 versus five hand consultants on the same radiographs
links.effect: ChatGPT 5 correctly identified 3 of 52 (5.8%); consultants 13.5-46.2% (mean 30.8%); humans had 7.26 times higher odds of correct identification (OR 7.26, 95% CI 2.27-23.18, p<0.001).
links.quote: In a standard logistic regression with clustered standard errors, the human cohort had 7.26 times higher odds of correct identification compared with the AI (OR 7.26, 95% CI 2.27-23.18, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks an off-the-shelf multimodal model (ChatGPT) against human consultants on an orthopaedic radiograph identification task without testing a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
